subject.statement: Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty to a money laundering charge and served four years in prison.

summary: Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty in November 2023 to a single count of failing to maintain an effective anti‑money laundering program (a Bank Secrecy Act violation), not to a money laundering charge. He received a short prison sentence (reportedly four months) and did not serve four years in prison.
